title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol, says it nearly matches GPT-6 Astra and costs less
slides: Can Sol nearly match Astra without the price tag?
OpenAI says GPT-6.1 Sol is cheaper than Astra.
Yet it nearly matches Astra on most benchmarks.
Your AI costs could drop without losing quality.
Test Sol on one real task. Compare now.
thread_text:
1. Sol nearly matches Astra?

OpenAI claims GPT-6.1 Sol is cheaper than Astra but still hits similar scores. That combination rarely happens.

2. The price-quality trade-off

Most cheap models sacrifice accuracy. Sol reportedly keeps quality high on benchmarks while cutting costs.

3. Why benchmarks lie

Real tasks often expose gaps. A model can ace tests yet fail on your specific workflow.

4. Your bill could shrink

If Sol delivers, you might reduce AI spend without downgrading output. That changes budget conversations.

5. Test Sol on one real task

Take a prompt you'd normally send to Astra. Run it through Sol. Compare the results yourself.
